1. The applicant, who is arraigned in CR No.80 of 2021 registered with Antophill Police Station,
Mumbai, for the offences punishable under Sections 302 and 201 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ("the Penal Code") and Section 4 read with Section 25 of the Arms Act, 1959,
alongwith accused No.1, her husband, has preferred this application to enlarge her on bail.

2. The gravamen of indictment against the applicant is that the applicant and accused No.1, who was a Police Naik in the office of Assistant Commissioner of Police, Sion, were residing at Shama Police Quarters alongwith her two daughters.

The applicant's parental home is at Akluj,
2-BA3883-2023.DOC Solapur.
On account of martial discord the applicant had stayed for a while at her parental home.
The applicant had lodged a report against her husband for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 read with Section 34 of the Penal Code.
The applicant had allegedly developed relationship outside marriage with Dada Jagdale (the deceased).

sentences.text: Accused No.1 had allegedly persuaded the applicant to rejoin the matrimony.
The deceased continued to visit the applicant at Mumbai.
Accused No.1 had, therefore, a grudge against the deceased.
As the deceased was not ready to snap the ties with his wife and children, the prosecution alleges, the applicant also had an axe to grind against the deceased.
4. On 29th September, 2021 accused No.1 called the deceased at his home.
The deceased was killed by the accused No.1 and the applicant.
His head, upper and lower limbs were chopped of.
The torso was left in front of the office of ACP.
The other parts of the body were destroyed by accused No.1 and the applicant.
5. The learned Counsel for the applicant submitted that the prosecution case rests on circumstantial evidence.
The motive attributed to the applicant and accused No.1 works 2-BA3883-2023.DOC out the retribution of the prosecution case.

Taking the Court through the material on record, including the statement of the daughter of the applicant and the neighbours and the injury certificates of the applicant, the learned Counsel submitted that, in fact, the applicant is the victim of the rage of accused No.1.
6.
The learned APP resisted the submissions on behalf of the applicant.
It was urged that the applicant was equally complicit in eliminating the deceased and destroying the evidence.
7. I find substance in the submission of the learned Counsel for the applicant.
The statement of the elder daughter of the applicant indicates that not only the applicant has sustained injuries on her person but she was found in a state of shock, after the alleged occurrence.

The neighbours have also stated that when they heard a huge noise, emanating from the house of the applicant, they came out of their homes and found the applicant in front of her home with an injury on her hand and when enquired as to what had happened, the applicant did not respond and went inside her room.

There is a statement of the Medical Officer which indicates that the husband of the applicant had stated 2-BA3883-2023.DOC that they had met with an accident and the applicant had sustained injuries in the said accident.
Before the Medical Officer at Sion Hospital, the applicant had stated that she had sustained injury while saving herself from the physical assault by her husband.

8. The aforesaid material is required to be appraised in the light of the probabilities of the case,
albeit prima facie.
The applicant and the deceased were allegedly in a relationship outside marriage.
The applicant had lodged report of matrimonial cruelty against accused No.1.
The statement of the daughter indicates that the applicant was in a stunned state.

In these circumstances, the question as to whether the applicant also shared the intention to eliminate the deceased (with whom she was allegedly in a relationship outside marriage) with accused No.1, would be a matter for adjudication at the trial.
9. The applicant is in custody since 9 th October, 2021.
She is a woman.
Investigation is complete.
Further detention of the applicant does not seem to be warranted.
I am, therefore, impelled to release the applicant on bail.

sentences.text:
Hence the following order:
:ORDER:
(i) Application stands allowed.
(ii) The applicant Monali Shivshankar Gaikwad be released on bail in CR No.80 of 2021 registered with Antophill Police Station,
Mumbai, on furnishing a P.R. Bond of Rs. 30,000/- with one or more sureties in the like amount.

(iii) The applicant shall mark her presence at the concerned police station on the first Monday of every alternate month in between 10.00 am. to 12.00 noon for the period of three years or till conclusion of the trial, whichever is earlier.
(iv) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence.

The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing the facts to Court or any police officer.

(v) On being released on bail, the applicant shall furnish her contact number and residential address to the investigating officer and shall keep him updated, in 2-BA3883-2023.DOC case there is any change.
(vi) The applicant shall regularly attend the proceedings before the jurisdictional Court.

(vii) By way of abundant caution, it is clarified that the observations made hereinabove are confined for the purpose of determination of the entitlement for bail and they may not be construed as an expression of opinion on the guilt or otherwise of the applicant and the trial Court shall not be influenced by any of the observations made hereinabove.
Application stands disposed.

[N. J. JAMADAR, J.]
